The subsystem and its position in the campaign are in subsystems.json, whose
link units and subsystems are listed in execution order; the path names
which subsystem this is. Waves run in order; the batches within one wave run
in parallel. A batch entry is a binder's or translator's task.json less its
run fields (base_branch, model, billing), which the orchestrator adds when
it writes the entry to wave-<w>/batch-<b>/task.json. Every
index also addresses the filesystem, so no path is recorded. Homes follow the
coding conventions: crustify/rust/<repo>/<link-unit>/, here for a repo named
widgets. A raw-lifetime subsystem's schedule holds one wave of one
